abstract: The outcome of clinical therapy of testis tumor presenting with positive human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in our hospital is reported. Of 110 patients with adult germ cell testis tumor, 19 (17.3%) had elevated hCG levels in serum or urine. Two (3.1%) of the 65 patients with seminoma and 17 (37.8%) of the 45 non-seminoma patients had positive hCG. Chorionic elements were confirmed at primary and/or metastatic sites in 10 (52.6%) of these patients, and in not a few cases different histologic features were seen at the two sites. Many patients with chorionic elements had high hCG levels (more than 3,000 mIU/ml) in serum, while patients in whom no chorionic elements were detected had low hCG levels (below 1,000 mIU/ml). The hCG-positive group seemed to have a poor prognosis because they were mostly in an advanced stage at their first visit to the hospital, and no difference in prognosis was found between the patients with chorionic elements and those without. The advanced group had a poor prognosis irrespective of their hCG levels.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性を呈した精巣腫瘍の本施設における臨床治療成績を報告する。成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍110例中19例(17.3%)で、血清または尿中のhCGが上昇していた。セミノーマ65例中2例(3.1%)、非セミノーマ45例中17例(37.8%)がhCG陽性であった。hCG陽性例10例(52.6%)では、原発巣および/または転移巣で絨毛成分が確認された。また、同一患者でも原発巣と転移巣で組織像が異なることが少なくなかった。絨毛成分を有する患者の多くは血清hCGが高値(3,000 mIU/ml以上)であり、絨毛成分が検出されなかった患者ではhCG値は低値(1,000 mIU/ml未満)であった。hCG陽性群は、初診時に進行例が多かったため予後不良と考えられた。絨毛成分の有無による予後の差は認められなかった。進行例はhCG値にかかわらず予後不良であった。
